gate.signInTitle: Sign in to your esy account
gate.signInBody: One account for the stores you own and everything you shop across esy.

hub.title: My esy account
hub.noStoreTitle: You don't have a store yet
hub.noStoreSub: Open your own and sell on esy.
hub.noStoreBody: Open your own store on esy. Pick a name and a look, add your first product and start selling.
hub.roleHint: If you work in someone else's store, ask the owner to give you a role. The store will appear here.
hub.managerNote: A manager handles orders and products. Only the owner sees the revenue.
hub.hereOrdersSub: What you ordered at {{store}}. Orders from every store are on esy.ge.
hub.ordersSub: From every store, in one list. An order opens in the store it was placed at.
hub.addrSub: One list for every store. At checkout your default address is filled in for you.
hub.addrEmpty: No addresses yet. Add one and checkout fills it in for you.
hub.addrRequired: Fill in the recipient, phone, city and address.
hub.saveError: Could not save the address. Try again.
hub.deleteError: Could not delete the address. Try again.
hub.deleteBody: Orders you already placed keep the address they were sent to.
hub.guestSub: Settings are kept in this browser
hub.guestSignIn: Sign in so your choices follow you to every device, with your orders and addresses in one place.
